memories.title: The Confession Chaos
memories.subtitle: When neither of us knew what we were, but both of us knew there was something there. ❤️‍🩹✨
memories.shortDescription: The first day our timelines crossed paths.
message: Nee plot reels, almost okay 10–15 days jarigindhi... iddaram confusion lo under Vallam. Every single day, we would come so close to confessing, only to go to bed that night with the same two things — a smile on our faces and a little disappointment in our hearts. 😂❤️ It was that beautiful kind of confusion where you don't know what the other person is thinking, but somehow, you both keep coming back to each other.

Aa rojulu bale undevi kadhaa.... No godavalu, just a lot of question marks, many more smiles, and tons of "Kovvu". 🫠❤️ Every conversation felt like it could be the conversation. Every reel, every little interaction, every unnecessary excuse to talk felt like another tiny step closer. Looking back now, those days feel almost unreal — like a little world of our own, where nothing had been said yet, but somehow everything was already being felt.

And finally... one day... Pinni villa intlooo. We had come back from shopping, completely fed up with mee, and all we wanted to do was sleep. 😭😂 But apparently, sleep wasn't the plan. All that was needed was your "BulliBojja" to light up the conversation, and somehow, that conversation led us straight to the confession we'd been circling around for days. And then came the weirdest confession known to mankind — "I love you and ur bulli Bojja." 😭❤️ The wording was chaotic, the situation was chaotic, we were chaotic... but I meant it. And maybe that's what makes this memory so beautiful — after all those question marks, smiles, confusion, and Kovvu, we finally had our answer. ❤️‍🔥

memories.title: The Face Reveal
memories.subtitle: Falling in love with someone before ever knowing what they looked like... and then finally seeing the face behind it all. ❤️
memories.shortDescription: Late night conversations suspended like underwater secrets.
message:
And somehow, this happened without even seeing you. I was already in love with the person you were — the way you spoke, the way you cared, the little things that slowly became familiar, and everything that made you... you. The face was never the reason I fell for you. It was just the one missing piece of a person I had already grown so attached to. 🫶🏻
And then, for our 2nd anniversary, after asking you for the 696969th time 😭, the face reveal finally happened. And there she was... Bujji bujji buggaleskoni bujji kukkkapilla laaga chinna pillalaaga bale undhi buddidhi. 🥹❤️ I genuinely don't know how many times I watched that photo. I remember even asking, “aaroju nyt photo save cheskunta”, and you actually said “chesko”. That tiny permission somehow made the whole thing even more special. 😂❤️

Actually, pics anni tarvatha delete chesesa... but I found it in our chat. Nenem daaachulole Talli... nijamgane chat lone undhi choosko kavalante. 😂❤️ And looking at it now, there's honestly no mystery about why that buddodu in the shopping mall was so amazed at youu. Maybe I finally understood what he saw that day — that same little face behind all the conversations, all the chaos, and all the love that had already happened long before I ever got to see it. ❤️‍🔥

memories.title: The Video Calls
memories.subtitle: From barely letting me see you... to becoming a little part of each other's everyday life. 📱❤️
memories.shortDescription: Points of light connecting into something permanent.
message:
I never expected we'd ever talk on video calls. You had barely accepted me enough to even let me see you — and that too, for the first time, almost two months after we met. 😂 So honestly, how could I have ever imagined that one day we'd casually end up spending hours on VC? But somehow, that happened. And it wasn't one big moment that got us there. It was built brick by brick — calling you and pretending it was “by mistake”, finding another reason to call, staying a little longer each time... until those calls became something completely normal for us. 🫶🏻
And then came everything that made those VCs ours. Studying together without even needing to talk, random fit checks, ummahss, Saree fit check, those sleepy early morning VCs... all those little moments that would've seemed so ordinary to anyone else but somehow became some of my favourite parts of us. ❤️ There was never really a need for some grand conversation. Sometimes just seeing you there was enough.
And ahhh... that day. 🥹 You were at home, sleeping, and somehow still lifted the VC. And there you were — bujji bujji buggaleskoni padkunpoyavvv. 😭❤️ I swear, my heart just melted looking at you like that. After everything — from barely being allowed to see you to having you casually pick up my video calls even while half-asleep — it felt like one of those tiny moments that quietly tells you just how far you've come. And maybe that's why those VCs became so beautiful... they weren't just video calls anymore. They were little pieces of our everyday life. ❤️‍🩹

memories.title: Our Language of Kovvu
memories.subtitle: A language that would sound completely ridiculous to everyone else, but somehow says everything to us. ❤️‍🩹
memories.shortDescription: Every scattered piece returning stronger than before.
message:
If anyone else ever saw the way we express things, they'd probably call it cringe, weird, or just say we're both madd. 😂 Even we sometimes see something like this from another couple and immediately go, "Chee." But somehow, when it's us, every ridiculous little thing has a meaning. Our "__:43", our monthly anniversaries, our unmans, the random names we call each other — none of it makes sense from the outside. And honestly, I don't think it ever needs to. Because somewhere along the way, we created a language that belongs only to us. 🫶🏻
And that __:43... maybe that's one of my favourite things about us. Every hour has a little 43 waiting inside it. It isn't just a number anymore. It's like, no matter what we're doing or where we are, there's a tiny invisible thread connecting us at that exact minute. We wish every :43 of the day because, in some strange little way, it feels like we're choosing each other again and again — 24 hours a day, one minute at a time. ⏳❤️ A minute that the rest of the world would never notice, but one that somehow belongs to us. And maybe that's what makes it beautiful: we took an ordinary minute and gave it our own meaning.

And then there are our Banda, kukka, pandhi... 😭😂 Words that would sound like insults in literally any other conversation, but between us carry an unreasonable amount of Kovvu. Every name has its own tone, its own story, its own level of affection hiding underneath it. And I can keep saying "I kovvu you" a hundred times, but somehow... when you say it, everything changes. 🥹❤️ I don't know what it is about hearing those words from you, but my heart just melts. Maybe because when you say "kovvu", I don't hear just a word — I hear you. I hear all the little moments we've built, all the ridiculousness, all the affection hiding behind the teasing, and everything that makes our love feel like ours. So yeah... maybe the whole world can call it cringe. Maybe even we can look at it sometimes and say "Chee." But I'd choose our weird little language every single time. Because nobody else needs to understand it. We do. ❤️‍🔥

interludes.title: A Little Something I Never Said...
interludes.subtitle: Some feelings are easier to write than to say.
paragraphs: Sometimes I wonder how something so beautiful started from such a simple little beginning.
Between all the random conversations, stupid jokes, endless reels and that never-ending Kovvu, somehow you became a part of my everyday life. ❤️
And somewhere along the way, without either of us noticing, talking to you stopped being just something I did... it became something I needed.
Maybe that's what makes all of this so special — we didn't plan this story. We just kept choosing each other, one little moment at a time. 🫶🏻

interludes.title: Before I Ever Saw You...
interludes.subtitle: Sometimes, you fall for a person long before you ever see their face.
paragraphs: I never needed to see your face to know that there was something about you I wanted to hold on to. ❤️
Somewhere between all those conversations, I had already fallen in love with the person behind the screen.
And then came that 696969th request... 😭😂 The face reveal I'd been waiting for finally happened.
Funny how I thought I was waiting to see your face, when in reality, I'd already fallen for everything that was underneath it. 🫶🏻❤️

interludes.title: Somewhere Along The Way...
interludes.subtitle: You quietly became part of the ordinary moments I never wanted to lose.
paragraphs: I think my favourite version of us is the one that exists when neither of us is trying to do anything special.
The random calls, the comfortable silences, the sleepy faces, the little smiles — somehow those became moments I'd want to keep forever. 🌙
You made ordinary days feel like they had something waiting for me at the end of them.
And if someone asked me what I would want back from all these days, I don't think I'd choose the big moments... I'd choose the little ones. The ones that were just us. ❤️

interludes.title: A Language Only We Speak
interludes.subtitle: Somewhere between the nonsense and the madness, we built our own little world.
paragraphs: Maybe love isn't always about finding the perfect words. Sometimes, it's about finding words that make absolutely no sense to anyone else. ❤️
A random number, a stupid nickname, a monthly little celebration — and suddenly, something ordinary becomes ours.
There are probably a thousand ways to say I love you. But I think I'd still choose all our weird ones. 🫶🏻
Because one day, when we look back at all of this, we'll probably laugh at how madd we were... and secretly miss every bit of it. ❤️‍🩹
